visual_action: Adrian Fontes, wearing a suit and glasses, sits on a stool and speaks directly to the camera. He is positioned between two American flags against a blue backdrop in what appears to be an office or studio setting.

cast.name: Adrian Fontes

on_screen_text.text: If you want to vote to help change the world,
If you're not registered, you can't vote.
Check with your local election officials
or your secretary of state for more information.

spoken_summary: Adrian Fontes, the Arizona Secretary of State, delivers a public service announcement urging people to register to vote. He states, "If you want to vote to help change the world, you got to register first." He advises viewers to contact their local election officials or Secretary of State's office for information on how to register.
audio_music: The audio consists solely of a man's voice speaking directly. There is no music or other sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot with no cuts or camera movement, in a typical talking-head style.
central_claim: In order to participate in elections, it is necessary to first register to vote.
intended_effect: To inform viewers about voter registration requirements and encourage them to register to vote or check their registration status.
